title: Memoirs of Hadrian
author: Marguerite Yourcenar
summary: Written as a long letter from the dying Roman emperor Hadrian to the young Marcus Aurelius, the novel reflects on power, travel, love for Antinous and the duties of ruling an empire.
readIf: you like meditative, finely written historical fiction about power and mortality.
skipIf: you want action, fast storytelling or a conventional plot.
